snippet.title: P0: Byte-Sized Brilliance -  Speed-running Anomaly Horror Game
snippet.description:
P0 is a speed-running anomaly horror where you have just 10 seconds to choose a button to smash. Oh, and grades matter when competing to score a far from average desk job. So, what are you waiting for? Crash through 30 floors and into the career of your dreams! ...Your life may just depend on it.

Launches Jan 20th on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4201810/P0_ByteSized_Brilliance
